title: 2.2 How do you go there?
unit_outcome: Say where and how people go, what people have and what things are, compare people and things, and understand classroom commands in Spanish.
goal: Say how people go: ¿Cómo vas a la alberca? Voy en bici. Luis va en carro. Sofía camina.
grammar_function: ir en + autobús/carro/bici; caminar; ¿Cómo vas…? ¿Cómo va…?
prerequisite: Spanish A1 Unit 2 and A1+ Unit 1 and A1+ 2.1-2.1.
